text:
alex: heads-up: seeing a TP all-reduce regression on 8xA100 in the nightly perf runs. latency cliff around small->mid message sizes (4KB-64KB).
priya: ugh, saw something similar on the 4k sweep yesterday, spikes align to KV cache boundary flushes?
alex: right — traces point to bursts of serialized allreduce windows when kernel_autoswitch flips between vectorized and fallback kernels. ring path seems to stall for ~2-3ms repeatedly.
mateo: can you paste the perf trace snippet? rough counters (PCIe, nvlink, nccl events) would help.
alex: pasted below (sanitized):
```
[trace] 00:00:01.234 A: allreduce_init id=42 size=8192
[trace] 00:00:01.236 A: kernel_switch -> fallback (vec->scalar)
[trace] 00:00:01.239 NC: ring_send start id=42 sz=8KB
[trace] 00:00:01.241 NC: ring_wait stall 2.1ms
[trace] 00:00:01.243 A: kvcache_flush prefix=3 len=4096
[trace] 00:00:01.246 NC: ring_send resume
```
priya: hmm the `kvcache_flush` at 00:00:01.243 looks coincident. Batcher churn + kv invalidation could be causing extra serialization windows.
jamie: are we sure it's ring-specific? tree fallback can have different handshake characteristics. can we force tree vs ring and compare?
alex: yes. I ran quick A/B yesterday: ring had higher p99 on 8KB, tree lowered p99 but throughput dropped under larger messages (>256KB). suggests topology+msgsize tradeoff.
mateo: let's run a microbenchmark that toggles kernel_autoswitch threshold + disables kvcache flushes (locally) to isolate. propose two runs: (A) force-tree, normal kvcache, (B) force-ring, kvcache-muted, (C) force-tree + kvcache-muted.
alex: agreed. test commands (run in perf harness):
```
./tools/perf/run_tp_allreduce.sh --gpus 8 --msgsize 8192 --pattern interleave --nccl-topology ring --env "RUNTIME_KERNEL_AUTOSWITCH=0.25" --trace out/ring-8192.log
./tools/perf/run_tp_allreduce.sh --gpus 8 --msgsize 8192 --pattern interleave --nccl-topology tree --env "RUNTIME_KERNEL_AUTOSWITCH=0.25" --env "KV_CACHE_DISABLED=1" --trace out/tree-8192-nokv.log
```
jamie: deploy-bot starting run A now. @mateo can you reserve the 8xA100 cluster on devpool-3?
deploy-bot: perf job 3532110001 queued on devpool-3 (owner: alex).
mateo: reserved devpool-3 10:00-11:00 UTC. I'll pin driver 525.85 for consistency.
priya: also add a trace that emits nccl chunk sizes and kernel selection decisions per step. we need to correlate window boundaries with kernel flips.
alex: good call — I'll add `--emit-kernel-decisions` flag to harness.
priya: if tree reduces latency but reduces throughput for >256KB, maybe runtime should route by msgsize: tree for <64KB, ring for >256KB, ring-tree hybrid for mid-range. we already have smart routing but kernel selector shouldn't thrash at the same time as routing.
jamie: +1. Also consider increasing the hysteresis on kernel_autoswitch to avoid flip-flopping on workloads with mixed msgsize tails. e.g., RUNTIME_KERNEL_HYSTERESIS_MS=10.
mateo: quick note: disabling kvcache globally hides some real load patterns. prefer a selective kvcache backoff probing knob in the harness rather than a full disable.
alex: ok I'll run pax: one run with full disable, one with backoff threshold 0.1.
priya: logging suggestion: add a compact timeline output with columns: step, msgsize, kernel, nccl-path, kv-event. that'll make it easier to eyeball correlations.
alex: implemented rough timeline exporter, pushing to `out/timeline-8192.tsv` after run.
mateo: once runs finish we should diff: p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, and nccl stall counts. also capture GPU occupancy snapshots around stalls.
jamie: if tree wins consistently at small sizes, we might add an adaptive routing rule in the scheduler: route-allreduce(msgsize) -> prefer-tree for <64KB, prefer-ring otherwise, with fallback. I'll draft a proposal after data.
alex: perf job started. will drop raw traces here when done. thx all. :thumbsup:
priya: thanks — if we confirm KV cache alignment is main contributor, we can add a lightweight KV prefetch to smooth boundaries. low risk experimental patch.
alex: noted. follow-up: I'll open a short RFC with data + proposed runtime knobs once runs complete.
jamie: cool. ping me when p99 curves are available.
deploy-bot: perf job 3532110001 finished: status=success, p50=1.2ms, p95=3.8ms, p99=7.1ms (ring, kv=on). logs: out/ring-8192.log
alex: uploading logs and timeline now. initial glance: clear clusters of stalls matching `kvcache_flush` events and kernel_switch. attaching quick diff after parsing.
priya: great, will take a look and post annotated flame.
